summary: Browse and search organizations and upcoming events, review official group pages, register for events, and join groups that match your interests.
steps: Open Groups or Events; search or filter by interest/category; open the official page; join the group or register for the event.

summary: Create an event from the group-management dashboard and enter the name, description, type, coordinator, date/time, and location.
steps: Manage Group > Events > Create Event; complete What, When, and Where; then add GW-required registration, visibility, and approval information.

summary: Update the logo, cover image, mission, membership benefits, constitution, officers, events, posts, news, photos, and visible sections.
steps: Manage Group > Dashboard > Group Page; edit page settings and individual sections.

summary: Add individual members or upload a member list and optionally notify them.
steps: Manage Group > Members > Current Members > Add Member, or select Upload Members for a bulk list.

summary: Add an existing member as an officer and assign the appropriate position.
steps: Manage Group > Dashboard > Officers > Add Officer; find the member and assign a position.

summary: Send targeted emails or newsletters, use notifications, and review open/click data. Events can also be shared through email, social media, chat, and mobile notifications.
steps: Choose a specific audience; write one clear call to action; test the message; send it; review opens, clicks, registrations, and attendance.

summary: Authorized event managers can use QR codes, student IDs, manual entry, computers, or the mobile app to record attendance.
steps: Open event check-in tools; choose an approved method; check in attendees; review the attendance report; follow up afterward.

summary: Create forms and surveys, set access and dates, notify officers, collect responses, and run elections.
steps: Manage Group > Forms/Surveys; create the form; set access, dates, notifications, and privacy; use the Election question type for elections.
